summary: QA Fixing_Prompt v13 regression on 8 defects (Testing case.xlsx). All 8 bugs verified fixed end-to-end. 10/10 backend pytests pass. UI verified for BUG #1 category page centering (1280px, mx-auto), BUG #2/#3 deep-link routing on SHOP home + MART home, BUG #4 admin banner-trio uploads a 2.9 MB PNG without 413 and displays preview (canvas → JPEG optimisation kicked in — result saved as .jpg), BUG #5 Category Grid drawer now shows 4-field tile (slug/display/icon/target link), BUG #6 phone code dropdown shows only +225(CI) and +91(IN) — no +231/LR, BUG #7 SHOP seller apply Step 5 renders 19 SHOP categories (Women's Fashion, Apple, Smartphones & Phones, etc.) — NOT MART — and PATCH accepts {category_id, module:'shop'}, BUG #8 Step 8 Documents + Step 3 Owner ID Document both use Choose file file-input (not URL input); uploaded PDF returns file_url under /api/martbaked/sellers/apply/{id}/files/… and preview link renders. Regression on MART home + SHOP home + MART product tile links all pass.
critical_code_review_comments: shared/suppliers/routes.py is now 1381 lines — mixes public draft flow, OTP, uploads, admin governance, module toggles, portal auth. Beyond the 700-line guideline. Split into e.g. suppliers/{apply_public,uploads,otp,admin_governance,portal_auth}.py for maintainability.

Public endpoint POST /api/martbaked/sellers/apply/{app_id}/uploads has zero authentication — anyone who guesses/enumerates app_ids can post files up to 8 MB. Acceptable while app is 'draft/action_required' but there is no rate limiting or CAPTCHA — trivial storage-cost DoS vector. Consider (a) throttling per-IP, (b) requiring the OTP challenge to have been consumed for that app_id before allowing uploads, (c) short-lived signed upload token issued at apply/start time.

GET /api/martbaked/sellers/apply/{app_id}/files/{path} likewise has no authz — files under any draft app are publicly retrievable if the caller knows both the app_id and the storage path. Draft docs typically contain PII (passport scans). Even if urls are unguessable, add a signed-URL / expiry or gate behind supplier session once submitted.

SellerApplyWizard StepCategories renders category tiles as clickable divs — I found 0 <input type=checkbox> elements. Fine for a11y since role is likely set, but confirm keyboard/screen-reader coverage.
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral SHOP supplier application supapp_90f4b77fcdf14c61 (MART-SUP-2026-00016) created + advanced to Step 8. One 2.9 MB PNG uploaded to homepage banner-trio drawer (was not saved via the drawer's Save button so it lives only on object storage until GC).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression file for these 8 bugs lives at /app/backend/tests/test_qa_fixing_prompt_v13.py (10 tests, all pass). SHOP category list endpoint is /api/shop/categories?country=CI and returns a LIST (not an object with 'categories' key) — same for /api/mart/categories. Step 5 backend contract: PATCH /api/martbaked/sellers/apply/{app_id}/step body {step:5, categories:[{category_id, module:'shop'|'mart'}]}. Without module='shop', SHOP ids are looked up in MartCategory table and 400. Public upload endpoint POST /api/martbaked/sellers/apply/{id}/uploads accepts multipart 'file' + optional 'kind' (document|image). Max 8 MB. Only works while app.status in ('draft','action_required'). To automate wizard end-to-end you can call the backend to skip OTP: /apply/otp/request returns dev_code in dev, /apply/otp/verify unlocks step 2.
